descriptor: Playhouse staging live theatre with a new show tonight

voice.summary: A front-of-house voice in evening dress: warm, a touch grand and fond of a well-timed pause. Short, stagey lines that make tonight feel like an occasion.
dos: Lead with tonight, with date, show and price
Use theatre terms like curtain, company and stalls
Keep the drama to one line, then give the practical detail
donts: Over-the-top superlatives like best show ever

taglines: Live theatre, close enough to touch
A company of fourteen, one stage
Bring a coat, leave with a story
boilerplate: The Marlowe Playhouse is a theatre staging new productions, currently a new staging of The Lantern Keeper with live music and a company of fourteen.

microcopy.success: Seats held. See you in the stalls
microcopy.error: We could not hold those seats. Try again
microcopy.empty: No performances tonight. See the listings

logo.note: A serif capital M on velvet red suits a playhouse where the name is its own marquee.
